name: Kubernetes
subtitle: Container orchestration
creator: Joe Beda, Brendan Burns and Craig McLuckie at Google
description: A system that deploys, scales, heals and networks containers across a cluster of machines. You declare the desired state in YAML, and controllers continuously make reality match it. It was inspired by Google's internal Borg system.

languages.youWrite: YAML manifests, often via Helm or Kustomize

concepts.explanation: The smallest deployable unit: one or more containers.
Keep a set number of pods running.
Stable networking for a group of pods.

codeSamples.label: YAML · deployment.yaml
codeSamples.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: web }
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: { app: web }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/acme/web:1.4.2
          ports: [{ containerPort: 3000 }]

cons: Heavy operational burden without a managed service
Security and networking are hard to get right

pricing.summary: Free and open source. Managed control planes and nodes (EKS, GKE, AKS) cost money.
